data_provenance.dataset_version: Earth Search sentinel-2-l2a harmonized COG DN; gain 0.0001, no second BOA offset; item processing baseline archived
Planetary Computer sentinel-1-rtc; item provenance archived

forest_definition.name: ungated anomaly screening; no forest definition applied

limitations: Monthly/seasonal disturbance is not automatically legal deforestation.
Hansen annual loss is not monthly ground truth; external/annual reconciliation remains necessary.
Optical anomalies can reflect phenology, clouds, fire, agriculture, moisture or other causes.
SAR changes depend on moisture, geometry, terrain and acquisition conditions.
S1/S2 agreement increases screening confidence but does not establish causal attribution.
Outputs are provisional candidates, not persistence-confirmed forest state or causal loss labels.
Terrain flattening and speckle filtering must be supplied upstream; this workflow does not implement them.
Pixel-centre AOI rasterization approximates boundary area at the configured resolution.
Optical quality masks are applied on the target grid; bilinear reprojection can mix values near cloud-mask boundaries.
Optical AND SAR: pixels lacking either sensor remain nodata.
No forest mask: anomalies cover all AOI land covers; candidate hectares are not forest-loss area.
Partial v2 coverage: emits provisional disturbance candidates; temporal persistence and confirmed forest-state labels are not implemented.
Terrain flattening and speckle filtering are external prerequisites, not implemented here.
Default optical median and SAR configurable mean/median; reference uses declared period-composites or legacy pooled-observations.
NDVI anomaly and seasonal decision thresholds are experimental user parameters, not canonical validated thresholds.
Weighted confidence is a weighted candidate-vote score, not calibrated probability.
No automatic S1-only fallback; select sar_only explicitly. Missing evidence is preserved as nodata.
Minimum component filtering uses 8-connectivity with bounded halos; no causal attribution.
Temporal aggregation (method capability capability:labeled-array-aggregation) uses NumPy arrays, which have no Forest Cover Lab tool record; tool:xarray is not used.
method:s1-backscatter-confirmation is implemented only as per-window SAR candidate evidence; observation:disturbance-confirmation is not produced.
method:moving-window-comparison lists observation:temporal-persistence; windows are compared independently and no persistence observation is produced.
NDMI, NBR and VV_MINUS_VH_DB are implementation features without Forest Cover Lab measurement records; only NDVI maps to measurement:ndvi.
Monthly, moving-window and matched-season modes, window sizes, steps and reference statistics are run configuration, not canonical scientific defaults.
